messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 ALERT — Dedicated pool surge detected (pool=d-ed-42, region=us-west-2). p95 latency > 500ms, error rate rising. Paging: @alex_m @sara_ops @liam_engineer
alex_m: oncall here, joining call now. start time 3832105432
sara_ops: joining, looking at autoscale and queue lengths
liam_engineer: seeing a spike from a small set of customers — top 3 sources account for ~68% of new connections, KV cache miss rate jumped 30%
megan_pm: support flags incoming from beta-corp and partnerX — multiple failed requests, some 429s
alex_m: quick impact assessment: consumer-facing text-gen endpoints (v2) p95 ~1.2s, some 503s for heavy requests. Affected: teamA-prod, beta-corp, partnerX. No full pool OOMs yet
sara_ops: mitigation options: 1) enable burst capacity for d-ed-42 (give extra reserved nodes) 2) apply temporary per-customer rate caps (customer-level shaping) 3) disable non-critical features (re-ranking, heavy sampling) on that pool 4) shift lower-priority traffic to fallback pool in us-east-1
liam_engineer: autoscale API ready. To enable burst: POST /internal/pools/42/burst {"enabled":true,"duration":3600}  — but need approval from oncall due to cost
alex_m: do it. prioritize latency reduction. deploy-bot, execute step 1
deploy-bot: ran action: POST /internal/pools/42/burst — response 200 OK — burst enabled (extra 4 nodes)
sara_ops: toggled burst ON. monitoring metrics (p95, qps, cache-miss)
liam_engineer: adding per-customer ratecap for top offenders at 120 rps as temporary backpressure
sara_ops: running admin command: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/admin/pools/42/ratecap" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"scope":"customer","targets":["beta-corp","partnerX","teamA-prod"],"limit_rps":120,"reason":"surge-mitigation-3832105432"}'
```
liam_engineer: applied caps for beta-corp and partnerX. teamA-prod set to 80 rps (they were the largest offender)
alex_m: immediate results: p95 dropped to ~360ms, error rate down 60% for affected customers
ton y_support: pinged contacts at beta-corp and partnerX, they see fewer errors but some throttles — advising they retry with exponential backoff. will send template note
megan_pm: customers want ETA on full recovery. what's next?
sara_ops: monitoring for 15m. If stable, keep burst on for 1 hour then evaluate. Follow-ups: create ticket to implement auto-gating (per-customer surge policies) and permanent per-customer qps controls
liam_engineer: logging decisions in incident timeline. note: KV cache miss triggered by increased unique prompt prefixes, will raise with model infra team to consider prefix caching heuristics
alex_m: creating INC-38321 for action items: owners = liam_engineer (infra fix), sara_ops (runbook + auto policies), devex (customer throttling docs)
sara_ops: adding short-term quota shift: bump reserved capacity for Dedicated tier customers by 10% to avoid collateral throttles, will revert in 4h
megan_pm: support coordinating a customer-facing update: "temporary capacity increase and rate limiting applied — you may see throttles; we're rolling mitigations now"
ton y_support: sent messages to impacted customers, added 60min status check-in
liam_engineer: note — disabled re-ranking on pool d-ed-42 for new requests (cheap toggle). command: `PATCH /internal/pools/42/features` {"re-ranking":false}
alex_m: disabled re-ranking. small quality tradeoff but large latency gain
sara_ops: metrics stable for 10m. p95 ~320ms, CPU utilization back in normal range
alex_m: handing off to sara_ops for the overnight watch. I'll be offline in 30m. Sara, please escalate to SRE if we regress
sara_ops: ack. I'll post hourly updates and escalate if p95 > 500ms or errors > baseline + 5%
incident-bot: Incident state updated: P1 -> monitoring. Notes: burst enabled, per-customer caps applied, re-ranking disabled, follow-up ticket INC-38321 created
megan_pm: thanks all. please attach logs and the curl snippets to the ticket. we'll prep a post-incident summary for customers tomorrow
ton y_support: adding notes to support tickets. will coordinate with megan on wording
sara_ops: leaving a final checklist: 1) verify rollback plan for burst (disable after stable) 2) remove temp ratecaps gradually 3) re-enable re-ranking once p95 stable < 350ms 4) postmortem owner assignment
liam_engineer: will take infra action items. grabbing initial metrics dump now
alex_m: thanks team — nice rapid mitigation. Handed off. :thumbsup:
sara_ops: taking over — locking thread for updates only.
